ms.text:
MP1 apparatus:
stopwatch and metre ruler and protractor
MP2 method:
measure independent variable
measure distance and time between points
repeat for different angle
MP3 source of inaccuracy (one from):
difficult to time at exact point,
ramp surface not regular,
trolley might travel at an angle across slope
MP4 control variable (one from):
distance from start to first point,
distance between points
MP5 table:
columns for independent variable, time and speed, all with units
MP6 analysis:
compare readings of angle with speed or time
plot line graph (with axes specified)
MP7 additional point (one from):
at least 5 sets of data taken,
repeat each measurement and take average,
2nd control variable stated
